I studied medicine, sociology, and economics at Korea University and social policy and health policy in graduate school. My research examines workplace mental health, labour, social policy, and health policy, with particular attention to the institutions and systems that shape them.

## Areas of Interest

Workplace Mental Health, Social Determinants of Health, Community Medicine, Health Workforce, Health Systems

## Education

- Hansung Science High School, Korea
- **BA**, Sociology, Economics (Minor), Korea University, Korea
- **MD**, Medicine, Korea University, Korea
- **MPP**, Public Policy (Social Policy, Industrial Policy), KDI School of Public Policy and Management, Korea
- **PhD**, Public Health (Health Policy and Management), Korea University Graduate School, Korea

### Mar 2020–Feb 2024

<details class="mk-entry mk-bullet">
<summary>Medical Intern, Korea University Medical Center (Mar 2020–Feb 2021)</summary>

**Key responsibilities**

Gained clinical experience across primary care, emergency medicine, and post-operative care.

</details>

<details class="mk-entry mk-bullet">
<summary>Medical Resident (Preventive Medicine), Korea University Medical Center (Mar 2021–Feb 2024)</summary>

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Preventive Medicine & Public Health Practice**

Contributed to national health promotion and disease prevention initiatives, focusing on workplace health programs and epidemiologic surveillance. Supported health checkups for the Livestock Health Control Association (2022) and proposed reforms to the 36-hour consecutive duty system for medical residents (2023). Gained practical experience in national mental health policy and service programs through secondment to the National Center for Mental Health (2023).

Secondment: Center for Mental Health Services, National Center for Mental Health, Jan 2023–Feb 2023.

**2. Preventive Medicine & Public Health Research**

Research social determinants of health, public mental health, and workplace well-being. Led or contributed to studies on medical residents' duty hours, COVID-19 and health equity, and spatiotemporal disease analyses. Presented work at conferences by the Korean Society for Preventive Medicine, the Korean Academy of Health Policy and Management, and the Korean Academy of Medical Sciences.

**3. General Clinical Practice**

Served as a patient care physician at Seoul's Community Treatment Center during the COVID-19 pandemic (2022).

Physician (part-time), COVID-19 Community Treatment Center, Seoul Metropolitan Government, Jan 2022–Jun 2022.

**4. Education & Teaching**

As a teaching assistant at Korea University College of Medicine, support courses in Preventive Medicine, Medical Law, and community-based clinical electives. Organize Preventive Medicine Grand Rounds to foster interactive learning and strengthen graduate-level training.

</details>
